batting.name: M Vijay
batting.dismissal: st AC Gilchrist b PP Chawla

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c PC Valthaty b P Kumar

batting.name: AC Gilchrist
batting.dismissal: c S Randiv b JA Morkel

batting.name: Sunny Singh
batting.dismissal: c SB Jakati b S Randiv

balls.text: Punjab began with two superb balls and have finished with another superb ball. Things have gone haywire in the intervening 19.3 overs. Chennai have got the highest score of IPL 2011. Dhoni was looking to find room and width again, Harris gave him none and pinged the base of middle stump with a stunning yorker. Middle peg goes for a walk, and Dhoni trots off with 43 off 20 balls to his name.
length ball, Dhoni targets cow corner again, but doesn't time it very well. Couple to deep midwicket.

Dhoni mistimes one of those heaved pulls, and even then doesn't find a fielder. Full toss angling in, Dhoni looks to whack over midwicket but can't time it too well. They run two, that's almost the default setting if the ball goes out of the circle.
very good last over so far, short delivery slanting into Badri who wasn't expecting it. Pulls a single backward of square.
very full, Dhoni stays on the back foot and looks to drive, and gets a single to wide mid on.
good yorker from Harris, Badri was on the hop as he tried to flick. Single to midwicket.
perfect yorker on the free-hit, Badri tries to make room as he stays on leg stump, but can't do much with it. Single to midwicket.
horrible time to bowl a no-ball. McLaren oversteps and sends down a low full toss on off. Dhoni takes a single. How he would love to be facing the free hit ...
bouncer, and a good one, angles in from outside off, leaving Dhoni with no room as he tries to steer. No contact made.
short ball, angling down the leg side, Badri helps it along with a slapped pull to deep backward square leg
another length ball, but the line was better this time. Dhoni drives on the bounce to long on for a single.

"It's not a bike baby, it's a chopper!" Dhoni could double up as Bruce Willis in Pulp Fiction as he pulls out the helicopter shot. McLaren lands a full toss on the pads, Dhonis's bat completes a beautiful circular arc of violence, and the ball lands just short of midwicket.
full delivery outside off, Badri opens the face and steers to point for one.

that's a slower version of Praveen's slower ball, it lands on a length well outside off, Dhoni contemplates life, the universe and everything before carving it over the covers. Four more. What an over.
yorker this time, Dhoni tries to dig back in the crease and crash it straight, but Praveen gets a hand to it.
he lands this one, for a change. Dhoni can't quite get under it and powers it without timing for two more to long on. They are running like the wind

Praveen's not making a very convincing case to Dhoni for his comeback to the India team. Another full toss on middle and leg, another murderous heave, another six runs over deep square leg. "Talk to the bottom hand," says Dhoni.

oh boy, Praveen did not get landing rights in Mohali, and he has landed somewhere outside Chandigarh. Full toss angling into the body, Dhoni smacks his lips as he smashes the forehand swat full over deep midwicket.

and life in the second spell is not the same. Chennai have got to 150 faster than any other team so far in this IPL. And that too from 0 for 2. Praveen sends down a neutered length ball and Dhoni whacks the leather off it with a swat straight back down the ground.
finally gets the near-perfect yorker, Dhoni drives to mid off for a single.
bouncer at 134 kph, Badri was taken by surprise and guided an ungainly pull to long on for one more.
short ball, Dhoni pounces on it and scythes the pull straight to deep square leg. It went so fast to the fielder, they had to hurry for the single.
legspinning slower ball at 114 kph well outside off, Badri drives into the covers for a single
low fulltoss on middle and off, Dhoni nearly gets under this one as well, but bunts it straight to long on for a single.
length ball to Dhoni is a poor idea. McLaren finds out why. Friendly ball landed on middle and leg, Dhoni clobbers it through midwicket with that muscular bottom hand coming into play.
fuller and faster, Badri skips out and looks to flick over the infield, and nearly gets four through wide mid on. Couple more.
this is not very good bowling. Bhatt sends down a slow, loopy full toss outside off, Badri crashes it inside out through covers.
fired in faster, Badri heaves without timing to midwicket for two more.
The chemical brother has got to his fifty. Another flighted ball on the stumps, Badri gladly jumps out to the pitch and blasts it down the ground for four.
short ball to Dhoni, who rocks back and hacks through the covers for a single.
Badri leaps out again, Bhatt keeps it full on leg stump and he drags it to long on for one

tossed up on middle and off, Dhoni pushes into the covers. Looked like a regulation dot ball, but Dhoni had found the gap. He sauntered across for the first run, bur Badri hared through. And then turned in a trice and bounded back for the second. Superb running.

Vijay is furious with himself. He has perished in the search for more runs to plunder. He jumps out and makes room to the leg side, Chawla lands it full on the toes and Vijay can't make contact as it beats him and goes through to the keeper. Stumped.
Aha! Vijay tries to play the reverse sweep as Chawla lands it well outside leg, he lets it go in the end outside leg, but the umpire doesn't wide it. Rightly so.
Chawla is being taken to the dry cleaners. This is bloodless violence. Vijay lopes out, gets to the flight of a juicy leggie and launches it a mile over long on.
this is the epitome of unimaginative bowling from Chawla. Unless he was trying to bowl him round the legs. Vijay gets across, laps the full ball outside leg to fine leg and doesn't run.Easy four.
full ball on leg, Badri muscles it down to long on for a single.
nice yorker to end the over, Vijay tries a Dhoni again, hanging back and lifting the back leg to get under it, but to no avail.
good comeback, keeps it fuller on off and Vijay can't get it away.
aha, the bouncer has disappeared too. Vijay was clearly late on the shot after pressing forward for the pull, ended up top edging it nearly all the way over the keeper's head.
smashed. Vijay is making room out of nowhere, standing outside leg stump and uncorking his wrists with furious power. Harris lands this full outside off and Vijay pummels through the covers.
this time he gets it away, heaving without much timing for a single.
unnecessary cheekiness, doesn't work. Looks to move across and lap-scoop, but misses the full ball.
jumps out to a full toss and drives inside out through covers for more runs.

The unhelmeted Vijay looks a bit like Dhoni. Right now, he's hitting them a bit like Dhoni. Launches a murderius slog sweep over cow corner and brings up 50. Shane Watson, the master of the slog sweep would approve.
Badri chips out again, Bhatt follows him and Badri twinkles the flick to square leg for one more.
Badri looks to dance away and go inside out, but finds cover with a well-timed shot
Vijay bashes a full ball right back and Bhatt can't collect it on the bounce.
fired in on middle and leg, Vijay can't get it away as he looks to muscle another one away., The helmet is off for Vijay. Symbolically, the gloves are off.
full on off stump, despite camping in the crease Vijay can't get under it and lofts without power to long off for a single.
full toss on the pads, Vijay will be disappointed he did not deposit this further away as he whipped with a vicious flick of the wrists. Two more.

that's a patent Vijay blow. He picked the slower ball so early, he was practicing this shot at the nets today. Slower ball at 104 kph, full on middle and leg, Vijay gets half across and delivers the roundhouse kick. Slap-swung away over midwicket.
full delivery on middle, Badri bunts to long on for a single.
width outside off this time, Badri goes through the covers and it takes a really good save to keep him down to a couple.
a hint of alumoonium in that shot! Crunching metallic finality to the way he connected with it. Nayar delivers a dolly, full on leg stump and Badri slap-slogs it through midwicket. Brutal.
very full to end the over, Badri can't get under it and drags a single to long on

"Best place in the world to hit a cricket ball," says Harsha Bhogle. Can't disagree. Badri skips out, making room, gets inside the line of a ball speared on middle and dumps it straight back down the ground.
on Vijay's pads this time, and he works it through square leg for one
flat delivery on the pads, Badri flicks to square leg for a single.
slides this one too far down the leg side. Called a wide.

these guys are running Punjab crazy. Another couple stolen. Tossed up on middle, nudged to mid on and they take off. Bhatt is late to realise they are on to two, and by the time deep midwicket comes across, they have hared across for the second.
flat delivery from round the wicket to start off, turns away and is heaved to long on off the back foot for one
the slider from Chawla, always round the corner, Badri squirts it off the inside edge to midwicket and they run like men possessed for a couple.
flatter and quicker, Badri stays on the crease and defends.

Badri's looking better and better. Mendeleef would have been proud of the alchemy in that shot. He gets forward, stays inside the line and lofts beautifully inside out, perfectly bisecting long off and the sweeper cover.
flatter, steered to a diving cover-point fielder and they get single.
banged away. That was quite full from Chawla, and Vijay did well to stay on leg stump and wind up even as he made room to bludgeon it straight. Chawla was wise to move his right hand out of the way.
tossed up on leg, Badri whips viciously through midwicket for one
Badri backs away again, and works a short of length ball to deep cover for one
back of a length offcutter, Vijay carefully nudges it with the deviation to mid on.
shuffles inside the line and glances backward of square for a single this time.
this time he looks to whip, but can't time the full ball past midwicket

Badri brings up CSK's fifty with a lofted off drive, he backs away a touch this time, knowing Nayar keeps it full and then tees off a touch inside out, ensuring he cleared mid off. Couple of bounces and over the ropes.
trundler, full on middle and leg, Vijay drives down to long on for one

top shot from Badri, he again looks to jump out but spots the short length soon enough to set up a solid base and bang the heaved pull emphatically over midwicket. He was so early on that, it went closer to wide long on, than deep midwicket.
Vijay works a fuller ball down through mid on for a single.

aha, what happened there? Badri looks to drive to the leg side, but it is not on the driving length and he gets it to the right of the pitch. They take off for an iffy single, Vijay jumps over the ball with McLaren behind him, attempting to intercept. Vijay, however, kicks it away by mistake as he jumps over it. Potential run out averted. McLaren has a wry smile.
not called a wide, but it is one for the over. Badri looks to get across and lap a short ball to fine leg, but he's late on the shot. Close call for a wide that.
angled in short of a length, Vijay tucks it backward of square for one more. He's looking quite good now.
Badri bounds out of the crease again, McLaren lands it short and down the leg side, Badri mis-hits the pull, the keeper can't collect and they pinch a single
googly landed back of a length, Badri reaches across and steers the cut in front of point for a single.
tossed up on the pads, worked into the midwicket region for a single.
hit with murderous power, but straight to cover. Tossed up and smashed straight to short cover.
he gets the single this time, under edging the cut to a short ball into the covers
shortens the length, played into the off side without timing
and he's welcomed with a boundary. Tossed up wide outside off and turning away, Vijay reaches to the pitch of it and tees off straight down the ground.
high full toss outside off to end the over, Vijay might have been taken by surprise as he pushed into the covers for a single.
back of a length on off stump, Vijay stays behind the line and defends to the off side
nice bouncer, that should keep them inside the crease! Vijay was looking to come out again, but ends up ducking out of the line.
aha, Vijay closes the bat early as he looks to flick and gets a leading edge down to third man
Badri saunters out, McLaren sees him and cramps him on leg stump. Badri nudges it off the pads to square leg for a couple.
skims the first ball off the surface and gets it to nip away from a nervy Badri poke outside off.
Praveen shortens the length, Vijay looks to dab a single into the covers but finds the fielder.

shot of the afternoon. Vijay's dumped the extra cover drive all the way. He plays this shot particularly well, and the slap-pull over midwicket. This was a length ball outside off, Vijay got across to the pitch and just smoked it through the line, it landed well behind the boundary skirting.
angled in, Badri looks to flick and can't get bat on it. Leg bye stolen to square leg.
Vijay's looking good now, getting forward and across with assurance and timing the cover drive nicely. He threads the gap and Badri once again responds for a third.

nice shot from Vijay, gets under a short ball from Praveen and executes the upper cut. Praveen doesn't provide much pace, and hence Vijay had to make all the running there. He got it just backward of square and nearly for six.
gentle inducker on off stump, Vijay defends from the crease. Needs to get forward.
ends the over with an emphatic bumper, had Badri jumping, swaying back and moving the head out of the way as it zoomed past him. Gilchrist collects it high and applauds.
Badri again wanders out of the crease, Harris hits the deck hard and gets it to bounce big. Badri had no chance of connecting with the walking cut.
Harris promptly shortens the length, Badri tries to carve through the off side despite not having the room and misses.
Badri's slammed him for the first four. Nice shot too, Badri leaps out of the crease to get to the pitch of the ball and then cracks it fluently wide of mid off for a boundary.
the heavy ball, Badri jumps and ducks and looks to work it to the leg side. Just manages to keep it away from the ribs.
the first shot of real confidence, but still no boundary. Vijay walks into a fluent cover drive and finds the gap. Not hit too hard and it slows up in the outfield, they get three.
there ain't no runs to be had. Badri looks to check drive through the off side, but Marsh dives away and intercepts.
that's a very strange shot. Badri gets well across and looks to lap Praveen from wide outside off, but doesn't get bat on it. It runs away towards midwicket and they get a couple
Vijay leans across outside off and opens the face to guide a single backward of point. Not so much devilish movement for Praveen now.
Badri leans out with more conviction into a square drive, and gets it away backward of point for a single.
back of a length on middle, Badri stays on the crease and nudges to the leg side
Praveen digs this well short of a length and outside off, but gets it to move away again. Easy leave for Badri.
short of a length to end the over, Vijay reaches across and steers towards point. This is a crawl of a start.
full, teasing length on middle and off, Vijay is late on the forward press but gets it away into the covers
Chennai get off the mark. Harris slants into the pads, Vijay is inside the line and tucks it square for a couple.
Vijay goes fishing now. Harris gets one to nip away from a length from outside off, Vijay stays rooted and searches for it. No  luck.
length ball on off and middle, defended solidly to the off side
angles the first ball into the pads from wide of the crease, Vijay defends to the leg side
he finishes with one that nips away, Badri lets it go. Stupendous over from Praveen. Spread the news, this might get some crowd into Mohali.
he's through him with an inducker. Praveen's darting the ball this way and that, CSK are struggling against the wobbling seam.
better from Badri, lets an away swinger go away to the keeper
play and a miss! Nervous poke outside off to a back of length ball that landed outside off and moved away a touch. Badri fishes and misses.

Praveen is on a hat-trick! 121 kph delivery, not much movement, comes in gently on a full length and Raina was too early on the flick. He scooped it straight up to midwicket inside the circle. Dolly. Chennai are reeling.

Praveen again strikes first ball! Lovely inswinger nails Anirudha in front. It's that patent delivery, bolt upright seam, tilting in, wafted up on a full length well outside off and then it curls in viciously. Anirudha got the front foot across for a cover drive and then saw it darting in, and tried to defend, but he was too far across and dead in front. Almost ended up looking like he wasn't playing a shot, that's how far bat was from ball!

Karthik seals it in style. Touch of irony for Chennai that the winning hit came from a man hailing from their own city. But the man who took it away is the mystery Mumbai marauder - Paul Valthaty. Karthik gets another length ball on the stumps from Jakati and launches it high over long on. Punjab have come to the party!

Val. Tha. Ty. Take a bow. Another short ball from Southee, the yorkers haven't come today. Valthaty waits, gets under it and heaves the upper cut into untenanted area behind backward point. Two to win off the 20th. Ms. Zinta seems to be overwhelmed by a swirl of emotions.
slower short ball at 104.4 kph, Valthaty doesn't pick it and misses the pull. Dhoni collects and they think of a single. He under arms a throw and misses, but they don't run.
anti-climax. A rare play and a miss as Southee gets a short ball past him quickly
start the tuk-tuk! Valthaty is taking them home here. Length ball from Southee, he sets himself up and bashes it with disdain through point.
short of a length on off stump, Karthik guides to third man for one more.

Even Dhoni makes mistakes! Stop the press! Length ball on the pads, Karthik looks to whiplash and gets a leading edge that takes off into the Punjab night. Dhoni ran back and to the left, got the cap off and steadied himself under it. He then moved some more, the ball swirled some more. And then he had to dive, but couldn't catch it!
short of a length outside off, Karthik steers through point for a single.
Chennai have crumbled under pressure today. Ashwin sends another one well down the leg side and Karthik laps it along past short fine leg for four.
Aswhin delays release and sends in a fullish ball on middle and off that is heaved to long off for one
short ball, but he was too early on the pull and toe-ended it to Ashwin
Karthik does the sane thing, works a full ball with the spin to midwicker for one
full on the stumps, driven down to long off for a single.
slower ball, lands back of a length and angles in, Valthaty steers to deep point for a single. He keeps strike.
full toss on leg stump, Morkel sends down another gift and Valthaty whips it almost to the square leg boundary. Sliding save keeps him down to two.
fuller and angling in, Valthaty drives into the covers and there's another misfield. Two more.

Morkel has disintegrated today. He has fine leg fine and no cover at deep backward point. And produces an over-pitched ball outside off. Valthaty responds by going down on a knee and steer-driving it through backward point. How cool was that shot!

put your hands together for Paul Valthaty! He's played the innings of  this IPL, and arguably the innings of all IPLs. Better ball from Morkel, full and just outside off, Valthaty gets a thick outside edge on the steer down to third man, He celebrates for a moment, looks overwhelmed for an instance, and then takes guard again. He wants to finish it off.
Valthaty is nearing a memorable 100 here. Morkel begins his spell with a pointless full toss on the pads and Valthaty smokes him through midwicket.
single to end the over. Doubt if Jakati will get another over.

Raina does some magic at long-on to save a sure boundary. Hideously short from Jakati, Valthaty digs back in the crease and bangs the heaved pull wide of long on. Raina runs across and slaps the ball back into the playing area just as it is about to fall over.
another reverse sweep, this time he gets it away squarer for a single
top shot from Karthik. Tossed up on leg, Karthik gets the front foot outside leg to stay outside the line and then reverse laps it to third man
fuller and straighter, Valthaty works it to long on for one. Into the 90s
horror ball to start off, and this game is back in the balance! Valthaty stays on leg stump to a short ball well outside off and goes up and over, into the covers. Disdainful shot
almost a yorker, Valthaty manages to crunch a straight drive and Southee gets a hand to it. Chennai are roaring back into the game now.
Southee is at it once again. You just can't predict his lengths. Bouncer now, Valthaty hasn't had strike for a while and doesn't pick it as it whizzes past.
Karthik is away, nudging a back of length ball on leg stump to midwicket for one. Nerveless over this from Southee.
Karthik looks to tap into the off side and get a single. Raina charges in from point, Karthik gets back into the crease and they go down in a heap!
inducker on off and coming into Karthik who works it to midwicket

he's a goner. Deer in front of the headlights. Did that land outside leg? Seemed unlike it on first viewing. Southee lands this on a length, straight and fast, no yorker, no swing. Nayar tries to play around the pad to the leg side and misses. Struck well in front. Given after a moment of consideration. Chennai are clawing back.

huge wicket for Chennai. Sunny is gone, and they will hope to stop the torrent now. Sunny again bounds out of the crease, but Randiv sees him and lands the floater outside off and gets it to go on. Sunny heaves and gets a big leading edge that is caught at backward point.
short and wide outside off, Valthaty cuts in front of square for a single.
slogged away from a length to Southee at deep midwicket for a couple. KXIP are on top here.
short ball, he swings across the line and misses. Dhoni doesn't collect cleanly.
fuller still, Valthaty crunches it to long on for a single.

top edged and safe. Morkel is not having the best evening out there. Full offie on leg stump, Valthaty top-edges the sweep, and Morkel has a year to run back and dive under it, but he goes around in circles and barely gets a finger to it.
flatter on middle this time, Sunny pushes into the covers and they decide against the single wisely.
and four more. The Raina hand is not working today. Flighted outside off, Sunny again leaps out and creams him inside out over extra cover. They are hitting everything, from both ends now!
Sunny side up! Valthaty has company. Sunny has launched a rocket out of Mohali. Tossed up on off stump, he screams down the track and deposits that out of the ground.
tails into the pads, worked with the spin for a single
flat and straight, on off stump and Valthaty plays it back to the bowler
offie on off stump, Sunny whips off the back foot to midwicket
flatter on middle and off, forced into the covers for a hustled single.
Sunny joins the fun now, gets inside the line of a harmless length ball and mows it across the line over midwicket.
short and fast, Valthaty camps back and hacks it past the bowler for a single to long off
Sunny jumps out and yorks himself, drives without much power to long on for a single
on the pads, not much turn, easily whipped through square leg for one more single
speared in from round the wicket, forced down to long on for one.
doosra on middle, calmly defended back down the track. Just in case you thought Valthaty is all attack!
Sunny is away, getting a single backward of square
on the pads from round the wicket, Valthaty sweeps backward of square for one more

try stopping this man! Randiv lands this short of a length outside off and breaks it in, Valthaty camps back in the crease and cracks it through the covers. Fielders flying everywhere, boundaries going everywhere.
oho, nice little doosra, beats the batsman, gets the leading edge and runs away to third man for four. Tough luck. Valthaty was squared up on the flick and will be happy with the outcome.

gone, Marsh is run out. Typical Twenty20 shambles there. Back of a length outside off, Marsh hangs back and steers through point who is tardy. They take a single and thinks of a second, but Valthaty sends Marsh back but he responds really late. Randiv collects a wide throw and has the presence of mind to under-arm it onto the stumps, Marsh's dive is in vain.
another off cutter to end the over, Marsh guides into the covers for the over's 15th run.
Styris keeps it very full, Valthaty forces it to long on for a single.

Valthaty clears the sightscreen now. He can play cricket, and by the looks of it he can play golf. Over-pitched offcutter on off, Valthaty steps into position and smokes it straight over the sight screen.
more like it, lands the offcutter on a length around off stump and Valthaty drives back to Styris
Valthaty rolls along. Appalling delivery from Styris, slants one a mile down the leg side and Valthaty laps it along to fine leg. He's hit better balls for fours today.
slow offcutter on middle and leg, driven off the front foot to long off for one
angled into the pads, whipped through backward square leg for one.
good running, Randiv fires it in and Marsh gets an inside edge to midwicket. Randiv has to field it himself, and they have enough time to get back.
over-pitched on middle, Valthaty drives against the spin into the covers for one.
another straighter one, half an appeal as Valthaty misses the sweep on leg stump and is hit in front of leg. Was it going down the leg side?
that's one of the few shots he's mishit today. Valthaty sashays out of the crease and looks to launch a doosra down the ground, but doesn't read it. Outside edge to third man for four.
tossed up and Marsh jumps out to take it on the full. Single to long off
quiet over, on the pads, flicked straight to deep backward square leg for a single. Only five off it.
the pleasures of having long off back. This time Valthaty's smashing on the up drive goes straight to the fielder back on the ropes
slowish ball on the pads, nudged round the corner for a single
back of a length, Valthaty forces from the crease to long off for a single.
short of a length, Marsh check drives into the covers for a quick single.
length ball on leg stump, Marsh works it quietly off the pads to midwicket
drag-sweeps a length ball on middle and leg to deep backward square leg for a single.
speared in on off, Marsh defends off the front foot
angled in to middle and leg, Marsh looks to lap sweep but can't get it away
Valthaty has made fifty in no time, nudging a big spinner with the turn to square leg
oh boy! Valthaty has played every shot in the book, and some outside it as well. Width outside off from Randiv, Valthaty stays put on off stump and late cuts for four more.
offie lands on middle and straightens, defended to the off side

Valthaty keeps bettering himself. Back of a length from Morkel, lands on off and Valthaty opens the face with a furious working of the wrists and cracks the ball on the up through the covers. The ball motors across Mohali for four more.

Gilchrist has holed out, what a tragedy for Punjab. Not the best ball to get a wicket. Full and angled into the pads, Gilchrist plays that trademark pick-up flick over backward square leg. Randiv was prowling in the deep, ran back and to his right to pouch it. Four years back, Gilly would have slammed that out of Punjab. Times have changed.
full delivery on middle, even Valthaty can't hit it. Driven into the covers for a single.
not so majestic this time. Four, all the same. Morkel gets the bouncer down with more pace this time and Valthaty is late on the pull. Top edged over Dhoni's head for four more.
majestic from Valthaty! Morkel bowls a sorry bouncer angling down the leg side, Valthaty stands on one leg, bends the knee and whacks it over deep square leg. Super shot.
starts off with a bouncer, Gilly charges out and top edges the pull to deep midwicket. Punjab get the fastest 50 of the tournament. Game on.
tight line, offie comes in from middle stump line and Valthaty forces it to mid off
angled into the pads, Gilchrist nudges through square leg for a single.

oh boy, Chennai are looking ragged in the field. Cover point and backward point left it for each other, and the ball sped through. Preity Zinta loves it and does a pirouette in the stands. Nice little cut from Gilchrist.
offie from over the stumps, Valthaty nudges to the leg side for a single.
he's just slapping them all! Another length ball from round the stumps, Valthaty gets half across to the line and lashes it away over mid on.
speared in from round the stumps, Gilchrist works it to midwicket for one

Val-thaty is playing Robin to Gilchrist's Batman. Val Kilmer more like it. Length ball from Southee, might want to just bowl yorkers from the start. Valthaty gets in line and spanks it on the up, between the bowler and mid off. Super shot.
length ball on off stump, Valthaty times the check drive ominously but Southee does well to defend down the track.
fuller from Southee, Valthaty drives on the up but finds cover this time.
Val-thaty runs this way or that don't matter! Paul has slammed a length ball from Southee straight back. Gets half forward, doesn't over reach and then cracks the forehand down the line.
fuller, but too straight, Gilchrist smokes it to deep square leg for one more

vintage Gilly. The short-arm pull is back. Southee lands one back of a length on the leg stump, Gilly hangs back, frowning at it, calibrating the bat swing and then unleashes the bottom hand. Fine leg had no chance.
horrible ball, Ashwin lands this a foot outside leg stump and Valthaty slog sweeps it along to backward square leg. Good start to Punjab's chase.
speared on the pads, Gilchrist bunts to long on for one more.
on the pads, Valthaty works with the spin through square leg for one.

dropped! Morkel misjudges what should have been a regulation catch running back. Valthaty advances and looks to loft the drive, he's not to the pitch and scoops it just over mid off, Morkel would have had the time to run back and make an attempt but chose to back pedal and dive back.
